title: Microsoft Purview DLP: adaptive scopes for SharePoint sites
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, documented controls and licensing statements are supported, and the DLP-specific documentation gaps remain accurately qualified. Two minor clarifications would make the UI routes more useful: finish the scope-definition route and explain that the static-policy route stops at the SharePoint location selector.

claims.quote: Adaptive Scope for SharePoint is a dynamic scoping capability in Microsoft Purview DLP that allows administrators to automatically target DLP policies to the right sites based on attributes
